title: open() macro in sim.h silently drops mode arg — footgun for future contributors
description: crypto2dev_sim.h:#define open(path, flags, ...) discards the third argument (mode). Any future contributor who adds open(path, O_CREAT|O_WRONLY, 0600) to a file that includes sim.h will get undefined file permissions with no compiler warning. The comment warns about this but the warning is inside the file — a contributor adding a new include from another file will not see it. The macro is correct for the current callsites (all O_RDWR|O_CLOEXEC with no mode), but the file-scoped hazard grows as the codebase evolves.
